technique_name: Summarize the findings of the latest climate change report.
description: The latest report from the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) paints a disturbing picture of the future of the planet. The report states that climate change poses an urgent and potentially irreversible threat to human societies and the natural world, causing more extreme weather, rising sea levels, and an increase in the frequency and intensity of droughts, floods, and extreme heat.
